user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop indexing box that advances an internal platform by one discrete step when rotated via an external hand crank, with the output remaining stationary between indexing events, enclosed in a protective housing.
product_intent: A mechanical device that advances an internal platform by discrete steps through manual rotation of an external crank while maintaining stationary output between steps, enclosed in a protective housing.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop indexing box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step
The output should remain stationary between indexing events
The mechanism should be enclosed inside a protective housing
The product should be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation
The number of indexed positions is not prescribed

requirements.statement: The product shall advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step when an external hand crank is rotated

verification.condition: One discrete step advance per crank rotation

requirements.statement: The output shall remain stationary between indexing events
The product shall be enclosed in a protective housing

verification.condition: All internal components protected from external environment

requirements.statement: The product shall be mechanically plausible
The product shall be easy to assemble

verification.condition: Simplified assembly procedures with minimal component interaction

requirements.statement: The product shall be practical to manufacture

verification.condition: Components can be produced with available manufacturing methods

requirements.statement: The product shall be suitable for repeated manual operation

verification.condition: Mechanism withstands repeated manual rotation without failure
Size appropriate for desktop placement and operation

requirements.statement: The product shall operate manually only

verification.condition: No power source or automated operation required

freedoms.subject: Number of indexed positions
freedoms.statement: The number of indexed positions is not prescribed

relations.rationale: The mechanism must be enclosed in housing to achieve the indexing function
The output must remain stationary, which requires proper housing enclosure

operating_scenarios.description: User rotates hand crank to advance indexing platform by one discrete step

operating_scenarios.name: Stationary Period
operating_scenarios.description: Output remains stationary between indexing events

operating_scenarios.name: Enclosed Operation
